2. An official appointed on 1-7-2007 is drawing a pay of ~ 34,000 in Level 3 from 1-7-2016. He is promoted to Level 5 on 1-8-2016. If he continues in Level 5 without any further promotion, when will he get his II MACP? Fix his pay on the date of MACP.  
## Ans:  
| His pay on promotion will be fixed as follows: | ~ |
| ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| Pay from 1-8-2016 | 35,900 |
| Date of II MACP (9 + 10 years) | 1-7-2026 |
